mechanism: In bmms_fused_nz only, move AIC CrossCoreWaitFlag(7) after MatmulImpl Init and SetOrgShape and before the first task/tensor/IterateAll. AIV packing can overlap independent Cube setup. No claim that official test 8 executes this branch or benefits.
scope: Existing packed gate only: M,N in [512,4096], original K in [512,2048], K%16!=0, M*N*K>=2^29, and (M%128!=0 or N%256!=0). All dtypes and layouts already supported by this gate remain included.

UB.pack_formula: x = 32768 input elements * 2 B at byte 0; z = 32768 input elements * 2 B at byte 65536. Buffers reused after pack.
UB.reduce_phase_formula: 4*tileM*min(tileN,128) + 8*round_up(M,8) + 8*tileM + 32768 bytes; unchanged host guard keeps this <= 180*1024 bytes.
UB.combined_lifetime: Packing and AIV reduction remain sequential and reuse UB; their sizes are not additive. Moving AIC setup creates no AIV UB allocation.

L1_L0: Existing TCubeTiling and SDK allocations byte-for-byte unchanged. No added residency, local tensor, queue, tile dimension, depth, event id, or new storage. Existing raw/API capacity differences are not modified by this scheduling-only experiment.
GM: Unchanged aligned packed A = round_up(B*storeM*kp*2,512), packed B = B*storeN*kp*2, existing two tile scratch slots per core, maxima and output.
synchronization: AIV pack PipeBarrier, SyncAll<true>, and CrossCoreSetFlag<2,PIPE_MTE3>(7) unchanged. AIC still consumes exactly one flag 7 before any SetTensor or IterateAll; no operand can be read before packing completes. TPipe construction and SDK event ownership unchanged. Existing output/scratch flags unchanged.

sdk_evidence.scheduler/base/scheduler_base.h:67-146: Init sets tiling/loop state, initializes local buffer pools and configuration; operand tensors have not been passed. CopyCubeIn A/B Init only allocates local resources.
sdk_evidence.stage/copy_cube_in/base/copy_cube_in_bas: Init calls CubeInBuffer::Init(size,depth). SetInput separately installs the operand tensor and resets its cache.
sdk_evidence.param/matmul_shape_info.h:287-303: SetOrgShape assigns M/N/Ka/Kb/Kc scalar fields; subBlock 0 uses local base fields.
sdk_evidence.impl/basic_api/kernel_tpipe_impl.h:558-5: InitShareBufStart/End configure local L1/L0C pools on arch2201; no operand GM transfer or cross-core barrier.

validation_policy: Source-only construction. Do not compile or run NPU in this subtask. Before future testing select every existing precision case and fixed-pool entry satisfying the unchanged packed gate, all existing dtype/layout/pattern instances, without timing-based filtering. Keep medium-K precision repair from s41c.
